after: FIRST MEASUREMENT on the 27 Oct 2026 draw: all 1,500 items (1,200 sealed and 300 public), one item per request, with Google's native probabilities for the choice, yes/no and score questions; model id gemini-decision-1, request-pinned. 3 of 1,500 requests failed in transport (one HTTP 503, two network errors) and count as wrong answers; Calibration is computed on the 1,497 answered items, as for every row with failed requests. No refusals. Latency was measured from our server in Germany. SELF-REPORTED FIGURE: Google reports 92.2 % (self-reported; accuracy on the 231 public v1.2 items, vendor-run; none of those items is in this draw). Our accuracy on all 1,500 items of the 27 Oct draw: 86.3 % (a yes/no answer between 20 % and 80 % counts as unsure, i.e. wrong). ImageJevBench v0.4-A Reasoning (separate scale): measured 23 Nov 2026, see /image-jev-bench/v0.4.
